status: Design for saved OOF predictions, no actual market values or new numerical model runs; the concrete runner schema/source must be frozen separately.
no_market_loading: The proposed summarizer accepts saved prediction/decision records only; it imports no engine or market loader and refuses final IDs.
information_contract: Every record binds outer/inner context, full training-ID list/hash, actual original scenarioID, original period t and predecision status. The actual ID must not belong to the fit training IDs for an OOF diagnostic.

At t0 no observed previous state is supplied and the only forecast is uniform. At t>=1 use3 real returns plus inflation from the actual previous calendar period and the corresponding previous-calendar training states; forecast weights apply to current-calendar training rows.

Store the forecast and physical action before applying actual current-year return/inflation. The realized outcome is appended afterward. A diagnostic may compute the one-step hold counterfactual on that same realized joint row without changing the actual path.

The forecast module is pure but cannot establish which calendar rows a caller supplies. The runner and independent auditor must separately enforce t-1/t alignment and the complete training/actual ID separation.

definitions.net_log_growth: For a training or realized joint row, log(next_real_wealth/(pretrade_V/pretrade_CPI)). Selected post holdings already pay the current exact fee; hold uses unchanged pretrade holdings and no hypothetical fee.
definitions.paired_benefit: For every row first compute log(next_real_wealth_selected/next_real_wealth_hold), then weight. Uniform uses that weighted mean; ensemble_min uses the minimum of those member means, not the difference of two minimum expected wealth levels.
definitions.next_running_MDD: Preserve original historical peak and running MDD: newpeak=max(oldpeak,nextrealwealth); newMDD=max(oldMDD,1-nextrealwealth/newpeak). Next-year exceedance is newMDD-L>1e-12.
definitions.probability_diagnostic: The weighted mass of next-year exceedance is a descriptive empirical forecast. Forecast weights are not calibrated true probabilities, and the support floor still constrains every calendar support row regardless of its forecast weight.
definitions.directional_support_miss: Actual selected next real wealth is below the minimum supported selected next real wealth by the frozen numerical wealth tolerance. This is a decision-direction support diagnostic, not complete joint-vector support membership.
definitions.floor_failure: Selected action passed the declared support-floor check, but realized next real wealth is below that same state floor. Also report actual new L events and already pending states separately.
definitions.no_continuous_point_equality_test: Do not define support coverage as equality of the continuous OOF joint row to one finite training tuple; that would mechanically label almost every observation a miss.
definitions.counterfactual_scope: Realized selected-vs-hold benefit is a one-step same-market physical-action contrast at the actual prestate. It does not replay alternative future policies and is not a full-H causal strategy improvement.

population_and_nulls: Use only genuine OOF records, no training resubstitution rows or final121-180. Retain excluded and malformed counts/reasons; fail on actual ID in training rather than silently calling it OOF.

Main prediction scoring covers predecision active-invested nonpending periods. Tabulate mandatory initial allocation separately from discretionary later growth/protection decisions; t0 is not a cost-benefit-selected trade.

Pending periods have no fresh policy forecast; keep their financial path outcomes in whole-H evaluation and mark prediction fields NULL. Initial Review has all financial/prediction outcomes NULL unless a separately named hypothetical diagnostic is explicitly declared.

Each scenario contributes its own within-path average/score first, then scenario means are averaged. Publish raw annual-row count and distinct scenario count, and do not treat annual rows or ensemble members as independent observations.
If a per-fit or per-forecast subset has no records, all calibration statistics are NULL, not zero error or perfect coverage. Forecast labels absent at t0 are not fabricated.

growth: RMSE of predicted net log growth against realized one-step net log growth
next_MDD: RMSE of expected next running MDD
Brier score for empirical next-L-exceedance mass
paired_benefit: mean forecast bias against one-step realized paired benefit
fraction with predicted benefit>1e-12 but realized benefit<=1e-12
sign agreement among nonzero predicted/realized benefits, with zero/tie counts retained
support: unconditional per-scenario fraction and conditional active-period fraction, with original denominators
predeclared_primary_diagnostics.reliability_bins: Fixed probability bins[0,1/3),[1/3,2/3),[2/3,1], publishing nrecords, nscenarios, mean predicted mass and actual event fraction. Empty bins NULL; three bins do not prove conditional calibration.
predeclared_primary_diagnostics.status_slices: Separate uniform and each member; inception versus later-active; growth versus protection. Use no post-result selected scenario or threshold bins.

uncertainty_and_selection_limits: Scenario-level block resampling of saved fixed OOF records can describe table uncertainty, not uncertainty of refitting the full learner. Overlapping fit training sets remain dependent.
Calibration diagnostics are audit/evaluation outputs of the frozen learner; they must not silently add a seventh model or tune rho/ensemble weights on outer outcomes.
Good empirical probability scoring does not prove a hard support boundary, recursive feasibility or full-H loss control. Whole-policy risk/coverage/cost remains the primary model evaluation.
All development data have a prior research history. New OOF separation is valuable algorithmic discipline, not an untouched analyst-level experiment.
implementation_next: After the concrete engine trace schema is fixed, implement a pure record summarizer with synthetic cases for OOF identity rejection, NULLs, t0 membership, bins/endpoints, scalar Brier/log-ratio formulas and scenario-equal aggregation. No raw-market parser is needed.
